title: Phase 4: promote consent and grant integration into core. Full spec: docs/MCP-PRODUCTION-FIX-PLAN.md
acceptance: lab private interaction bridge client ported into the real backend using AUTH_BRIDGE_URL, timeout, and secret configuration
session-protected login continuation and consent endpoints/UI showing registered client, requested scopes, and calendars; never trust a user id from the browser payload
on approval upsert exactly one active grant for the authenticated user and OAuth client_id, intersecting requested scopes/calendars with the live allowed set, then resume the interaction
on denial create no grant; retries idempotent; approval cannot broaden an existing grant
all user_id = 0 and empty-list placeholders replaced; list, narrow, and revoke routes session-bound and ownership-checked
immediate revocation preserved by checking the authoritative grant and live calendar membership for every tool invocation
